snippet.title: Castle in the Sands | Out May 2026
snippet.description:
"Castle in the Sands" is a pixel art visual novel set in a world inspired by "One Thousand and One Nights" and North African culture. The adventure begins in the heart of the desert and leads you to fairytale places full of magic and danger.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4463700/Castle_in_the_Sands/

Follow Winter Apple: 
X: https://x.com/winterapple_dev
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/winter-apple-dev.bsky.social

Music credits: Janne Hanhisuanto for Radakan
